{"id":1960517754,"question_id":3215,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774584910,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1960517754/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Matrix Similarity After Cyclic Shifts","memory":"31.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool areSimilar(vector<vector<int>>& mat, int k) {\n        int n = mat.size();\n        int m = mat[0].size();\n\n        k = k % m;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                if(i % 2 == 0) \n                {\n                    if(mat[i][j] != mat[i][(j+k) % m]) return false;\n                }\n                else if(mat[i][j] != mat[i][(j-k+m) % m]) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    \n        return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"matrix-similarity-after-cyclic-shifts","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1872}
